properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued for Buffalo Bayou and Brays Bayou corridors, Harris County
properties.description: Doppler radar indicated heavy rain producing flash flooding in the warned area. Between 4 and 7 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall of 2 to 4 inches is possible.
properties.instruction: Turn around, don't drown. Do not enter flood waters.
